message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a multi-axis controller (joystick) for fork trucks. I recall CBP classifying such joystick controllers under 8537.10 (boards, panels, consoles, desks, cabinets and other bases equipped with two or more apparatus of heading 8535 or 8536, for electric control, for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V). Alternatively, they could fall under 8443.. no. Parts of fork trucks, 8431.20, would be the other candidate. However, the joystick has a PCBA, switches and a sensor, and it controls the truck electrically, so 8537.10 fits. The subheading is 8537.10.9170 ("Other" for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V, other, controllers). Section XVII notes would not exclude it, since Section XVI Note 2 directs parts of goods in 8537 to that heading. I'll go with 8537.10.9170.
